messages:
Sam: quick update — ran the bring-up for marlin-embed-small (baseline fp16) and an experimental per-channel int6 quant. ran the standard wiki_holdout semantic sim suite + cluster checks.

Sam: summary numbers: recall@10: fp16=0.802, int6=0.777 (-3.1% abs), recall@1: fp16=0.641, int6=0.618 (-2.3%); silhouette (cosine) fp16=0.42, int6=0.35 (down ~0.07).

Sam: command used:```bash
python tools/eval_embeddings.py --model marlin-embed-small --quant int6 --dataset wiki_holdout --k 10 --normalize True
```

Anya: thanks Sam. can you paste 3 failing query examples (orig query + top 3 results fp16 vs int6)? that helps tell if it's semantic drift vs scale mismatch.

Sam: pasted three short examples below (query -> fp16_top1 || int6_top1)
- "how to reset docker network" -> "docker network prune" || "docker run --net=host ..."
- "symptoms of b12 deficiency" -> "vitamin b12 deficiency symptoms" || "iron deficiency anemia"
- "best way to cache thumbnails" -> "use CDN + cache control" || "store locally and invalidation"

Sam: looks like nearest neighbor flips on close syntactic variants — some are harmless, some semantically wrong. not a global collapse.

Liam: two quick thoughts: 1) Are you using the exact same L2/cosine normalization pre/post quant? small scale shifts can swap neighbors. 2) Try cosine vs dot to see if magnitude changed.

Liam: also, did you try the per-channel scale calibration vs global? int6 per-channel should help, but if calibration set was short it can bias toward frequent tokens/anchors.

Ciara: re calibration — we saw a similar pattern with raven-compact where tail queries moved. can you rerun with:```json
{ "calib_batch": 4096, "calib_dataset": "wiki_sample_10k", "symmetric": true }
```
and also run whitening (PCA 128 -> whiten) to check cluster shape.

Sam: ok i'll kick two jobs: (A) int6 per-channel re-calib with wiki_sample_10k and symmetric scales; (B) int6 + PCA whiten (fit on train corpus) then eval.

Anya: please include the small manual sanity check: run 200 random queries and compute neighbor-stability = fraction of top-10 that are identical between fp16 and int6. if <0.85 we escalate.

Sam: noted. i'll post results. starting jobs now. (embed-bot: job 49272 queued)

embed-bot: Job 49272 started on cluster-gamma (marlin-embed-small | quant=int6 | calib=wiki_sample_10k)

Sam: quick interim — per-channel re-calib improved neighbor-stability to 0.88 and recall@10 delta narrowed to -1.5%. silhouette improved to 0.39.

Anya: nice. can you share a couple of the previously bad examples to confirm fix?

Sam: the docker network one now matches fp16. the b12 example still off by top-1 but top-3 contains correct.

Ciara: sounds like mostly calibration. still want to run the PCA whiten experiment though to see if cluster separation improves. could help downstream K-Means retrieval.

Liam: also file a short eval note in the onboarding doc: link the exact commit, quant recipe, calib params, and neighbor-stability metric. good to have a reproducible rollback.

Sam: will do. plan: if PCA whiten + calib gets neighbor-stability >0.9 and recall drop <1%, we mark marlin-embed-small-int6 as viable for dedicated test. otherwise keep fp16 for production.

Anya: +1. thanks everyone.

embed-bot: Job 49272 finished (duration 00:14:22) — results uploaded to s3://redwood-evals/marlin/3500001234/

Sam: results uploaded and I'll add a short PR to the onboarding repo with the analysis and artifacts. (reaction :raised_hands:)
